title: Impact, the anime fan game of my dreams is LIVE!
author: Class_Muted
selftext:
Hey again guys   
It’s been a while since I last posted here about [making my dream anime fan game](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/s/YnUUj4x5DJ). I received lots of valuable feedback, comment, threats, hate, but most importantly, love.

So I doubled down on the game and increased the number of fighters to 96 from 22 different anime, 17 iconic battle locations, 7 unique modes, created 500+ VFX specifically for this game, and much much more.

I also revamped the UI and did a lot of optimization work, so much that the game is running an average of 140+ FPS on players PCs so far!

Anyways, I thought I should pop back in here to thank you all for your help and feedback and share the link to the game. It’s still in early stages, and I’ll keep expanding and improving the game as models get better, but would love to hear what you all think of it now!

P.S. For all the proper here looking for a bit of inspiration to finish and publish their games despite all the AI hate, I just shared the game on my tw around couple of hours ago and it already has 100+ players and 255+ plays so far!

Play the game for free [Here](https://playertwo.lol/).  
[Launch Tweet](https://x.com/TheDudeCommits/status/2116160330602823930) \- [20+ Minutes of Gameplay](https://x.com/thedudecommits/status/2115473201769935228?a=1mmZ3a4Mcx6mXA2FW80&s=46)
